description: This file contains validation functions for serving cell configuration in a 5G NR scheduler, including checks for PDCCH, PDSCH, PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, and CSI measurement configurations, with specific focus on 3GPP specifications and resource collision detection.

classes.name: config_validators
classes.description: A class containing static methods for validating various aspects of serving cell configurations.

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PDCCH configuration within a serving cell, including coreset and search space IDs, and candidate counts.

methods.name: validate_zp_csi_rs
methods.description: Validates zero-power CSI-RS resources and their consistency with CSI measurement configuration.

methods.name: validate_pdsch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PDSCH configuration, including resource list and zero-power CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: validate_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PUCCH configuration, including resource sets, formats, and CSI report settings.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg
methods.description: Validates the PUSCH configuration, including power control and beta offsets.

methods.name: validate_srs_cfg
methods.description: Validates the SRS configuration, including resource set and resource list parameters.

methods.name: validate_nzp_csi_rs_list
methods.description: Validates NZP-CSI-RS resource list for uniqueness, collision, and TDD slot scheduling.

methods.name: validate_csi_meas_cfg
methods.description: Validates CSI measurement configuration, including resource set IDs, resource list, and report configurations.
